verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Genie Code as an AI assistant and autonomous agent. It generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and asks approval before using tools. Genie and Genie One separately let users ask data questions in natural language, on web and mobile, and create dashboards from natural language. Together these show the product's core work can be driven by natural-language commands. Missing for 10: evidence that administrative and workspace operations (compute, permissions, jobs configuration) can be driven via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the NL operation works.
